name: Wythe
why: Lost Americana remade — the oxford Miles Davis wore, the pearl snap James Dean wore, cut to fit and built to be handed down.
origin: Peter Middleton, a Texan who worked in fabric research at Ralph Lauren and before that at Faherty. Began as a Kickstarter oxford in 2019; store at 59 Orchard Street, Manhattan.
opview: Middleton on why he does his own cloth: at Ralph, 90% of the fabrics were custom developed — taking something from stock was not an option. Very few brands work that way.

onething.n: the first thing they made, Kickstarter 2019; custom-woven cloth. Link best-guess

notes.murica: Recovering a lost American wardrobe garment by garment, with cloth developed rather than sourced. The reference points are Miles Davis and James Dean, and the intent is restoration rather than pastiche.

cities: Online · select specialty · one own shop in New York
